directive.gatingQuestion: Does Planet's 98% recurring ACV and strong backlog materially contradict reported revenue growth that partly benefited from point-in-time satellite hardware delivery?
directive.whyItMatters: The packet independently routes unresolved_material_contradiction to Deep Resolver; this classification can be adjudicated without taking over Alpha-owned primary-source corroboration or scoring work.
directive.preferredEvidencePath: Active PL packet plus SEC Q2 FY2027 10-Q already present in packet lineage.
directive.successCondition: Determine whether recurring ACV/backlog and point-in-time hardware contribution are mutually inconsistent, while preserving revenue-mix, durability, profitability and Alpha-owned provenance unknowns.

adjudication.evidence: The active packet simultaneously records 98% recurring ACV/strong backlog and identifies point-in-time satellite hardware delivery as a contributor to reported revenue growth; it also preserves GAAP loss, capital intensity and contract-mix risks.
adjudication.inference: Recurring ACV is a contract-mix measure, while period revenue can include both recurring services and point-in-time hardware. Those observations can coexist. The hardware contribution limits how much headline growth may be interpreted as recurring expansion, but it does not factually contradict the recurring ACV/backlog observation.
adjudication.gateImpact: Resolve unresolved_material_contradiction only. Preserve Alpha-owned primary-source corroboration, factor/score/risk/confidence work and all non-gating economics/concentration unknowns.

evidenceVsInference.observed: Recurring ACV/backlog strength and point-in-time hardware contribution are separately represented in active structured evidence.
evidenceVsInference.inferred: They describe different revenue dimensions and are logically compatible; hardware mix remains a caution on growth quality.

failedStrategy: Prior resolver lineage did not clear the material-contradiction label despite the packet already separating recurring contract mix from hardware revenue timing.
changedStrategy: Adjudicated the accounting/mix compatibility directly and explicitly deferred the separate primary-source corroboration defect to Council Alpha.
